category_title: 📐 Skills 效能与上下文 ROI Card (10套)

variants.title: Token Altimeter · 上下文高度计
variants.p0: S12: Search P95 18,400 tok; inspect the oversized-result proposal
variants.axis_y: Persistent vertical Lenses; evidence replaces the trailing inspector; other metrics reuse the instrument stage
variants.layout: Three-column instrument: narrow lens mast, wide zero-based burn plot, trailing action inspector

variants.title: The ROI Ledger · 回报率批注账页
variants.p0: S10: Atlas ROI score 0.4; review one low-ROI proposal without claiming monetary return
variants.axis_y: Editorial index with a single selected ledger leaf; evidence opens as marginal annotations
variants.layout: Asymmetric ledger: slim index, central ranking leaf, wide annotation margin

variants.title: Pin Check Desk · 固定版本核对台
variants.p0: S1: 2 of 8 inspected consumers have pin drift; review a safe alignment plan
variants.axis_y: Single-active Quality accordion with inline consumer evidence and a compact supporting proposal rail
variants.layout: Wide accordion worktable beside a narrow plan pocket, with product Lenses embedded in the worktable heading

variants.title: Selective Read Gate · 渐进阅读闸口
variants.p0: S7: 15% observed deep-read violations; inspect selective disclosure, without inventing an L2 stage
variants.axis_y: A gateway chart turns over in place to expose provenance; sibling disclosure metrics occupy mutually exclusive leaves
variants.layout: Centered branching reading plane with a shallow left lens index and an inset right intervention column

variants.title: Context Atlas · 五片上下文地图
variants.p0: S11: Tool results occupy 40% of an estimated 50,000-token context; inspect a result-budget hypothesis
variants.axis_y: Direct-select mosaic with a side legend that becomes a slice inspector; other Lenses replace the whole atlas
variants.layout: Poster split: large typographic left margin and an area-faithful right mosaic with integrated labels

variants.title: After the Skill · 使用后的安静复盘
variants.p0: S8: 18 post-skill edit events across 20 observed sessions; review the associated outcome, not a causal verdict
variants.axis_y: A focus-stage evidence curtain replaces the numeric field; alternative metrics are quiet chapter links
variants.layout: Centered calm stage flanked by an origin margin on the left and a narrow vertical chapter navigation on the right

variants.title: Gate Balance · 拦截与噪声天平
variants.p0: S2: review 4 noisy runs out of 40; do not confuse catch rate with recall or precision
variants.axis_y: A comparison bridge opens a full-width evidence row below the selected track while sibling Quality findings stay in a compact selector
variants.layout: Offset comparison bridge: wide twin-track analysis on the left, narrow decision column on the right, no persistent sidebar

variants.title: Practice Pocket · 加载与实践卡袋
variants.p0: S4/S6: Atlas has 40 loads, 12 script executions and 20% observed script touch; inspect the practice gap honestly
variants.axis_y: Four solid domain cards retain true overlapping pocket geometry; only the selected front card is readable; evidence pulls out within that card
variants.layout: Left overlapping domain pocket stack with one front analytical card and a compact right review slip

variants.title: Eval Fieldbook · 健康与评测活页
variants.p0: S3: 9 of 12 skills passed audit; inspect three non-passing audit entries separately from eval count
variants.axis_y: A foldout audit leaf opens from the selected audit mark; product Lenses are spine tabs; one audit leaf at a time
variants.layout: Open fieldbook spread: narrow tabbed spine, large audit page, facing evidence leaf that replaces the review page

variants.title: Escape Casebook · 归因分诊卷宗
variants.p0: S9: 5 [SPEC_GAP] escape records; review specification evidence rather than routing blame automatically
variants.axis_y: Two attribution branches lead into one selected case leaf; an evidence file opens in place; no modal pile
variants.layout: Bifurcated casebook: left domain rail, upper two-lane attribution plot and lower selected-case dossier within one solid stage
